name: capture_adb_screen
description: Capture one frame of the device screen as a PNG (`screencap -p` through exec-out, no device-side file) into a caller-selected output directory, digesting it and reporting its dimensions. No recording or interaction.

__schema0.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it

__schema1.description: Local directory for the captured PNG; must not already contain it

output_directory.description: Local directory for the captured PNG; must not already contain it

serial.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it
